purpose: Test whether dense full peaks trivially provide within-5-ms candidates at wrong times; this audits the diagnostic, not the system score
population: Same 29 audible objects and E10-incorrect subset as the frozen main diagnostic
comparison: Weighted fraction with any full peak within 5 ms of actual+shift; compare with actual-centered correct-peak availability
selectionPolicy: Nearest full peak to shifted center; ties by smaller absolute distance then smaller peak time
confirmationSetPolicy: Do not read confirmation audio, candidates or labels
